identification.summary: The MISP threat-actor galaxy lists PREDATOR PANDA as an adversary group with country code CN and no description or references in the entry seen [S1].
identification.notes: The name follows the CrowdStrike 'PANDA' cryptonym convention for China-nexus actors, but no CrowdStrike profile page for PREDATOR PANDA appeared in web searches, and the CrowdStrike 2013 Global Threat Report contents seen in search coverage did not list a PREDATOR PANDA section [S1].

gaps: No vendor report, government document or press coverage describing PREDATOR PANDA activity was found; the only hits naming it were MISP galaxy entries (a bare adversary-groups entry [S1]; a threat-actor cluster entry was reported in search snippets as carrying a CN tag and a CrowdStrike report reference, not verified).
The CrowdStrike Global Threat Report PDF listed in the existing record (go.crowdstrike.com) could not be opened (host not resolvable), so any mention of PREDATOR PANDA there is unverified.
The MISP galaxy file itself could not be fetched; the entry details come from the search tool's summary only.
No Microsoft name mapping, MITRE group ID, aliases, TTPs, malware, targets, timeframe or sponsor are established.
Possible overlap with other CrowdStrike PANDA clusters or other vendors' names is unknown.
